label: Codex CLI
invocation: describe the task; the skill activates on its description
notes: Codex loads SKILL.md skills from .agents/skills (project) and ~/.agents/skills or ~/.codex/skills (user), most specific first, with the same name+description frontmatter Claude Code uses. Paths confirmed from documentation, not against a live install.
